description: Reads the running game. Operations: tree: the live scene tree, with current_scene naming the scene shown; text: every line of text under nodePath in reading order, as drawn, without what is hidden; find: the nodes matching className, script, namePattern, group or says, with property read off each; rect (needs nodePath): one node's rectangle or position in canvas and window pixels; property (needs nodePath, property): what one property reads on a node, or through the objects it holds; metrics: frame time, memory, draw calls and the rest; accessibility: what the game tells a screen reader, in a windowed Windows run started with engineArgs ["--accessibility", "always"] or accessibility_support at Always Active. Default tree.

className.description: A native class, matching its subclasses too, or a class_name. For op find.

depth.description: Levels to descend, 0 for the node alone. Default 3. For op tree.

group.description: A group the node is in. For op find.

includeHidden.description: Count hidden nodes and controls outside the viewport. text: default false. find: default true. For ops text, find.

includeProperties.description: Include every stored property. Large, so prefer properties. For op tree.

limit.description: find: most nodes, default 100. text: most lines, default 500. accessibility: most elements, default all. At most 5000. For ops find, text, accessibility.

metrics.description: Which to read. Default all. For op metrics.

namePattern.description: A case-insensitive glob on the whole node name, such as "Enemy*", or alternatives split at |, such as "Enemy*|Boss". Write \| for a bar in a name. For op find.

nodePath.description: tree, find, text: where to start, default /root. rect, property, accessibility: the node. A unique name "%Player" works. property also takes an engine singleton, as runtime_invoke does. Not for op metrics.

properties.description: tree: properties to read off each node, colon paths allowed. accessibility: the fields to keep, such as ["role", "name"]. For ops tree, accessibility.

property.description: The property to read, or a script constant. A colon path reads through what a node holds: "_game:clock:speed", "_game:run:roster:0:traits", "size:x". A step written as a call, "get_viewport():gui_get_focus_owner()", calls an engine method marked as only reading, with literal arguments, 'get_theme_constant("separation")'. It also calls a game method taking no arguments unless declared -> void, even one that changes the game, and runtime_wait until calls it every frame. A negative index counts from the end, and a key holding a colon is quoted, 'stock:"base:water"'. For ops property, find.

says.description: The words a node shows, as drawn, case-insensitive. A bare word matches anywhere in the text. * or ? makes a glob over the whole text. | splits alternatives. accessibility: filters elements by name, value or value_text. For ops find, accessibility.

script.description: The script file the node carries. For op find.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before answering pending with a requestId, which runtime_invoke op result collects. Default 10000, accessibility 75000.

name: runtime_inspect
title: Inspect the running game
